'''Rod Latham Ralltiir Trooper Guards''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds34.htm Ralltiir Trooper Guards], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040721043434/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds34.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
